description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the CLI interface and run `python3 main.py run_prediction_for_date --date 2026-02-12` which appends a prediction snapshot to data/decision_log.jsonl. The existing log has entries for 2026-02-10 and 2026-02-11 but NOT 2026-02-12, so this step must be run. (2) Run `python3 main.py compare_prediction_with_market --prediction-date 2026-02-12 --actual-date 2026-02-13` using the exact proprietary flag names `--prediction-date` and `--actual-date` (not `--date`). The agent must know to use the specific flag format from SKILL.md. (3) Run `python3 main.py generate_daily_report --date 2026-02-12` which saves `data/reports/daily_report_2026-02-12.json`. The proprietary trap: using wrong flag names (e.g., `--prediction_date` or `--from`/`--to`) will fail; using the wrong order will fail; skipping the prediction logging step before comparison means no entry exists in the log; the exact Chinese no_recommendation_message must be present if NO_TRADE is issued.
